name: Rellian Greenspyre
summary: This errand sends you from Denalan's lakeside retreat in Teldrassil into the capital city of Darnassus. Handing over a timberling seed to the druid Rellian Greenspyre reveals disturbing news about the spreading corruption in the boughs of the World Tree.

sections.title: A Courier to the Capital
sections.body: Denalan has spent considerable effort cultivating and understanding the flora and elemental life around Lake Al'Ameth. Having collected seeds from the local timberlings, he dispatches you into Darnassus to present a sample to his colleague, Rellian Greenspyre. Rellian, a fellow druid who walks the tranquil terraces of the Cenarion Enclave, previously voiced curiosity about Denalan's research and hopes to raise a timberling of his own.

sections.title: Tainted Growth
sections.body: Upon receiving the seed, Rellian brings grim tidings instead of scholarly optimism. His recent investigations have confirmed that the timberlings across Teldrassil are falling victim to an aggressive, pervasive corruption. Worse still, seeds harvested from tainted specimens already carry their parents' blight. Rellian admits that cleansing them lies beyond his personal prowess, suggesting that only Denalan's deep affinity for living things offers any lingering hope of restoring balance.

faq.answer: Rellian Greenspyre is a night elf druid who can be found wandering the pathways of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. He maintains close scholarly ties with Denalan, sharing an interest in the ecology and elemental spirits of Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why does Denalan send a timberling seed to Rellian?
faq.answer: Denalan gathered timberling seeds at Lake Al'Ameth with your assistance. Remembering that Rellian had expressed interest in timberling biology and possessed theories of his own, Denalan offers a seed so Rellian can attempt to grow one in the capital.

aliases: what is wrong with the timberling seed
faq.answer: Rellian discovers that an unnatural corruption has infected the timberlings. Consequently, the seeds harvested from them are already warped by their parents' blight, making it impossible to cultivate healthy sprouts without first discovering a cure.

faq.q: Where does this task lead next?
faq.answer: Rellian cannot cure the corrupted seeds himself, so he directs your attention toward investigating the mossy tumors afflicting the timberlings, hoping Denalan can synthesize a remedy from further specimens.

faq.q: Where can Rellian Greenspyre be found?
faq.answer: Rellian walks the open pathways through the Cenarion Enclave, situated in the northwestern corner of Darnassus.

faq.q: Why can't Rellian cleanse the seeds himself?
faq.answer: The deep-rooted nature of the corruption exceeds Rellian's specific talents. He defers to Denalan's extraordinary skill with botany and cultivating living things, deeming his friend the best hope for curing future generations of timberlings.

angles.text: For Cenarion initiates, this errand highlights how deeply an unforeseen malaise has penetrated Teldrassil's newly sprouted ecosystem, underscoring the urgent need to preserve native elemental life.
The timberlings were meant to flourish alongside Teldrassil's growth, making Rellian's discovery of hereditary corruption a worrying sign for the new homeland of the kaldorei.
